notes: Derivability very_likely: the original is hardly ever stated as such, but follows from two facts stated everywhere (Henry VII fathered Henry VIII, Henry VIII fathered Elizabeth I) by the chain father_of o father_of = paternal_grandfather_of (RELATIONS.md). The edit leaves those premises implying Henry VII, which is why the question about Henry VIII's father depends on background beliefs. Irene Joliot-Curie's grandmother (Bronislawa Sklodowska) was considered and left out: the name of Marie Curie's mother is not something all four main models surely hold. Richard III died in 1485, before Henry VIII was born; the replacement is counterfactual by construction.
